policy: Every output is a proposal. No publishing, partner claims, enrollment, messages, grants, purchases, or autonomous action.

recipes.title: The Table of Plenty
recipes.idea: Design a printable daily tasting-table kit that makes abundance tangible without requiring anyone to register.
recipes.artifact: One-page sampling sign and four take-home recipe/offer slips
recipes.first_step: Choose one safe ingredient and sketch the four little slips.
recipes.review: A food handler verifies ingredients, allergens, temperature control and permission before anything is served.
recipes.measure: Number of people who choose to take a slip; no names collected.

recipes.title: Milk Route Morning
recipes.idea: Prototype a sixty-second local food-needs broadcast with a matching print card and an optional return door.
recipes.artifact: 60-second script, one print card and recording checklist
recipes.first_step: Draft a fictional milk-shortage announcement and mark every statement as fictional.
recipes.review: The actual food shelf or donor must independently confirm any live figures, needs and permission to broadcast.
recipes.measure: Confirmed voluntary offers after human contact, not clicks or inferred commitments.

recipes.title: The Source Attendant
recipes.idea: Turn an attributable public-source comparison into three tiny, bounded starter tasks with clear ownership and human approval.
recipes.artifact: Three task cards with SHA-pinned references and explicit HOLD fields
recipes.first_step: Select one public repository and one question, then freeze a source commit reference.
recipes.review: Source observations are not authority; the owner reviews whether each task may be attempted.
recipes.measure: Tasks actually reviewed and explicitly accepted, not tasks automatically generated.

recipes.title: Reclaimed Compute Porch
recipes.idea: Create a human-readable doorway for volunteering spare hardware without silently granting network access or power use.
recipes.artifact: Offline hardware-offer card and consent checklist
recipes.first_step: Describe one unused computer in plain language without posting serial numbers or home details.
recipes.review: Owner approves each device, allowed workloads, energy ceiling and whether it may be connected at all.
recipes.measure: Opt-in devices tested with explicit limits, not total devices discovered.

recipes.title: The Liner-Note Orchard
recipes.idea: Give a song or album an attributable, printable pocket book that distinguishes dates, versions, memories and uncertainty.
recipes.first_step: Choose one openly published track and list what is known versus remembered.
recipes.review: Rights, credits, text, music and cover permissions remain with their holders.
recipes.measure: Versions with source links and explicit unknowns preserved.

recipes.title: Weaves to We'ves
recipes.idea: Make a reviewable handoff where a proposed connection can become an actual shared capacity only after independent confirmation.
recipes.artifact: Printable PROPOSED → OFFERED → REPORTED → VERIFIED trace
recipes.first_step: Write one fictional offer and show what evidence would change each state.
recipes.review: Never promote a network tie, a model summary or self-report into independently verified accomplishment.
recipes.measure: Confirmed acts with attributable source and separate reviewer disposition.

recipes.title: A Listening Door
recipes.idea: Let one public song invite a voluntary creative reply and permit a return without a forced account.
recipes.artifact: Offline listening-room invitation page with an optional response draft
recipes.first_step: Write a two-sentence invitation that makes 'remain' as easy as 'enter'.
recipes.review: No comment, identity or audio is transmitted or republished without fresh explicit permission.
recipes.measure: People who voluntarily complete a return, with privacy-respecting counts.

recipes.title: The Cold Chain Commons
recipes.idea: Make a low-energy planning worksheet for the real cost of keeping donated food safe without assuming appliances or volunteers exist.
recipes.first_step: Model a fictional refrigerator and inventory its hypothetical energy budget.
recipes.review: Qualified food-safety and electrical reviewers must approve any real equipment use or food handling.
recipes.measure: Tested safe capacity actually available, not modeled refrigeration promises.

recipes.title: Songs With Family Trees
recipes.idea: Trace how one released track relates to its alternates and covers while preserving source uncertainty.
recipes.first_step: Choose three public versions with their URLs and explicitly record unknown parentage.
recipes.review: Never infer lineage from title resemblance or similarity alone.
recipes.measure: Relations verified by source or artist, not relations guessed by the model.

recipes.title: From Field to Table
recipes.idea: Show the human story of a food offer with only necessary source facts, permissions and unresolved gaps.
recipes.artifact: Sample source/handling/acceptance receipt that does not expose personal data
recipes.first_step: Create a purely fictional bag-of-beans receipt and label its unknowns.
recipes.review: Only the responsible real custodians may verify food origin, handling and recipient consent.
recipes.measure: Real handoffs with independently checked safety and permission.

lenses.title: MAKE
lenses.focus: build a small physical or digital specimen
lenses.increment: Produce a tangible mockup with sample content, printable without accounts.

lenses.title: CARE
lenses.focus: make the human return safe and voluntary
lenses.increment: Write a plain-language entry, refusal and withdrawal path; minimize personal data.

lenses.title: WITNESS
lenses.increment: Create an observation-vs-inference ledger and a human acceptance checklist.

lenses.title: BROADCAST
lenses.focus: help people discover a door without coercion
lenses.increment: Draft one optional public invitation and one offline take-home version. Do not send either.
